fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $45,000, non-refundable and due in lump sum upon signing. Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces who qualify under the IFA VetFran Program and own at least 50% interest in the franchise are eligible for a reduced fee of $30,000 (a $15,000 discount). During the last fiscal year, fees were uniformly applied.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a single Franchised Business is $45,000. ... Purchasers of a Window World franchise who are veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces are eligible to receive a reduced initial franchise fee of $30,000 (representing a $15,000 discount off our standard $45,000 initial franchise fee).
